name: Illo Don Juan
source:
Juan Alberto has received an anonymous declaration of love. Will he be able to find out who sent it?
Someone has sent Juan Alberto an anonymous gift with a very nice note. Everything indicates that he has been a close friend.

The love note was written on a clipping from a kebab pamphlet. If Juan Alberto finds the rest of the pamphlet, he will know who he was. 

To do this, he will go search the rooms of the three suspicious friends: Lil Bokeron, Guillem the Frutem, and KNekro.

However, Juan Alberto is too upset about the subject, and everything, everything, EVERYTHING, seems suspicious to him...

[Translated from [url=https://andylotu.itch.io/illo-don-juan]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
胡安·阿尔韦托收到了一封匿名情书。他能查出是谁写的吗？
有人匿名寄给胡安一份礼物，还附上了一张情真意切的字条。种种迹象都表明，寄件人是他的一个好友。

情书写在从烤肉店传单上剪下的一角。只要找到剩下的那份传单，胡安就知道是谁了。

为此，他打算搜搜三个可疑朋友的房间：Lil Bokeron、Guillem the Frutem和KNekro。

可胡安实在太在意这件事了，如今在他眼里，什么都可疑，什么都可疑，真的是一切都可疑…

（译自[url=https://andylotu.itch.io/illo-don-juan]itch.io[/url]）
